about_the_game:
One Hit Wizard
A compact, score-chasing micro-roguelite where every input matters. Preview an element with W/A/S/D, clear with Q, commit your attack with the Arrow Keys, and beat the timer. Miss the pattern… and the wizard takes 1d4 damage!!!

Core Loop

Read the enemy’s required attack direction and (sometimes) element.
Preview element with W/A/S/D → clear with Q.
Commit the attack with Arrow Keys (↑ High, ↓ Low, ← Left, → Right).
Succeed to score and advance; fail and take damage.

Key Features

Micro-length runs & instant restarts — press R or use the Restart button.
Element mind-games — some enemies need an element; T4 needs none (just the right arrow). Beating T4 with no element selected heals +1
Score & Best — your best run is saved; reset anytime.
Clear menus — Start (Start / Reset Best / Quit), opens Pause (Resume / Restart / Quit), on death shows restart prompt.
Readable HUD — health as text
Keyboard-on — low friction, high focus.
How to Play (Quick)
W/A/S/D = Preview element • Q = Clear • Arrow Keys = Attack • ESC = Pause • R = Restart

No music/SFX yet
